title: One sample, many resamples
hook: Three data points can make 27 ordered resamples. Inspect what varies.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: resample your own data thousands of times to get an interval without formulas.

misconception: Treating bootstrap as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: resample your own data thousands of times to get an interval without formulas.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: Your data are 2, 4, and 6. You enumerate every size-3 resample with replacement and average each. What is the mean of those resample means?
